task_instance: From a small sample team-standup transcript, create and maintain a portable Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) 'meeting' vault: initialize the bundle, add a raw source note plus two source-grounded concept notes and an action (with footnote citations and relative Markdown links), refresh indexes and the update log, then verify OKF structural conformance.
evidence: Created work dir and a local venv (python 3.13), installed pyyaml 6.0.3 into it. Copied the skill's scripts/vault.py into the work dir and wrote a sample transcript as input (inputs/standup_transcript.txt). Ran '.venv/bin/python scripts/vault.py init vault --title "Team Sync Vault" --profile meeting' -> exit 0, created 11 files (9 category index.md, root index.md, log.md). Authored OKF-conformant notes per references/format.md: vault/sources/team-sync-2026-10-28.md (type Source, raw transcript preserved), vault/concepts/ingestion-event-drops.md and vault/concepts/batch-postgres-writes.md (type Concept, status draft, sources[] with id+resource, generated.by/at offset-aware, workflow_status, claims attributed via [^sync-2026-10-28] footnotes linking to the source), vault/actions/batch-writes-ticket.md (type Action with open task checkboxes). Refreshed the three category indexes with relative Markdown links and appended a dated ISO heading to log.md reporting source cutoff and the unresolved SRE-runbook question. Verification: ran 'scripts/vault.py audit vault' -> exit 0, output {documents: 15, errors: [], warnings: [], core_structure_passed: true}. Vault is plain UTF-8 Markdown, readable without Obsidian; Obsidian/Dataview options were not requested and not installed. Deliverable files are under <work>/vault/.
note: The skill's documentation references a specification URL and reference files that use placeholders; none of those external resources were needed to produce or verify the deliverable. Obsidian/Dataview setup (optional) was not exercised because it was not part of the chosen minimal core task.
